description: [forged] Offline normalizer/validator for phone numbers to E.164 format. Detects country from a leading '+' calling code or an optional defaultCountry (ISO2) hint, and checks the national number length against a basic rules table for LatAm, US/CA, EU (ES,PT,FR,DE,IT,GB). No network calls; approximate validation only (length-based, not full carrier rules). (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

defaultCountry.description: ISO2 country code to assume if phone has no country code, e.g. US, BR, MX

phone.description: Phone number, digits with optional +, spaces, dashes, parentheses

name: phone_e164_normalize
